node.label: Crossed fused renal ectopia
node.definition: A developmental anomaly in which the kidneys are fused and localized on the same side of the midline. This anomaly is thought to result from disruption of the normal embryologic migration of the kidneys.

evidence.snippet: Hypertelorism-microtia-facial clefting syndrome: Crossed fused renal ectopia (frequency HP:0040282) [TAS]
